en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a European market square lined with historic gabled houses and a prominent town hall-like building. In the background stands a tall red-brick tower with a green spire. There is a fountain or lamp in the open square and a horse-drawn carriage in the foreground. The printed captions identify the location as Nijmegen and the marketplace (Markt). A vertical publisher imprint is visible along the left edge.
